stemBlocks: The arrow in the diagram shows the net movement of molecule X out of a healthy mammalian cell. The maximum cell width is $10 \ \mu \text{m}$. The cell membrane accounts for $0.2\%$ of this width.
What is the width of a single cell membrane, in nm, and which process is represented by the arrow in the diagram?

|  | width of a single cell membrane / nm | process represented by the arrow in the diagram |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 0.01 | diffusion |
| B | 0.01 | active transport |
| C | 0.02 | diffusion |
| D | 0.02 | active transport |
| E | 10 | diffusion |
| F | 10 | active transport |
| G | 20 | diffusion |
| H | 20 | active transport |
